preconditions.description: The number of balls n must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of swaps m must be between 1 and 200,000.
The initial position k of the special ball must be between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n and x_i != y_i for x_i, y_i in swaps)
preconditions.description: Each swap must involve valid positions and must not swap a ball with itself.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.
Each integer in the output must be at least -1.
At least one position must have a minimum of 0 faked swaps.
